Fact-check (confirmed by arithmetic): every annual cooling consumption figure equals Pdesignc x 350 h / SEER within rounding (FTXF25F 135, FTXF35F 188, FTXF50F 269, FTXM25A 92, FTXM35A 132, FTXM50A 224, FTXA25C 100, FTXJ25A 100 kWh/a).
